zh-Hans: 官方活动 · 承接关系

en: Only the duties that are yours for this event
zh-Hans: 只处理属于你的本场职责

en: Events where the platform has invited you to deliver appear here — this is the only entry point for taking part in an official event. Accepting, declining and leaving are all audited; being shown on an event does not mean you have accepted it.
zh-Hans: 平台点名邀请你履约的活动都在这里，这是官方活动唯一的承接入口。接受、拒绝和退出都会保留审计；被活动展示不等于已经承接。
